content: I’m on a flight with my family reading research on the intelligence of birds, as one does. My daughter has been training crows in our neighborhood for months now. I exported a 62-page paper to a PDF and asked ChatGPT to write an article for a high school newspaper (for my daughter). Results were pretty good, but took a little effort, which might have to do with the custom instructions I’m currently using, which likely aren’t the best for this sort of prompt.
